tools.name: check_product
tools.description: Audit a single product page for how well AI shopping assistants can read and recommend it. Takes the product page URL and returns a 0-100 score with findings on structured data (Product/Offer schema), price and availability markup, images, description quality and identifiers such as GTIN and brand.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_store_readiness, check_product, check_acp_feed, check_merchant_feed, check_llms_txt · Private data: check_llms_txt · Public sink: check_store_readiness · Destructive: check_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_store_readiness, check_product, check_acp_feed, check_merchant_feed, check_llms_txt · Private data: check_llms_txt · Public sink: check_store_readiness · Destructive: check_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
